::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru India Development Centre (BIDC) was established through the 2009 acquisition of PulseCore Semiconductor, expanded via the 2011 Cypress image sensing acquisition. Supports the global Intelligent Sensing and Analog Solutions groups.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Image sensor ICs for automotive ADAS and industrial machine vision, power management ICs, and analog signal conditioning circuits.
